searchText: should we just normalize this ot [host](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/host) or [hostname](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/hostname), maybe having port part of it could be useful for testing but why do we need to sign over the scheme and other parts of the url? also related, I mentioned the trailing slash problem here already https://github.com/JasonVranek/epbs-config-flow/pull/1#discussion_r3789290387 <@346498651553660928> might be able to write here, there is a discord glitch that allows to write in threads I think, or maybe it's just a misconfig on this server yea agree with Nico, so hex-encoded UTF-8 bytes of the builder's ***[host](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/host)*** ? and to be explicit, since the auth data contains opaque bytes, a builder can check any encoding / agree with proposers out-of-protocol on encodings. this ^ should be how VCs create normalized auth data from the `url` iff a user doesn't supply auth data directly via keymanager API for that builder

yea agree with Nico, so hex-encoded UTF-8 bytes of the builder's ***[host](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/URL/host)*** ?

and to be explicit, since the auth data contains opaque bytes, a builder can check any encoding / agree with proposers out-of-protocol on encodings. this ^ should be how VCs create normalized auth data from the `url` iff a user doesn't supply auth data directly via keymanager API for that builder
